name: Counterparty Credit Risk & XVA
description: Derivative and securities-financing counterparty exposure and valuation adjustments.

metrics.name: current_exposure
metrics.description: Positive mark-to-market after netting and collateral

metrics.name: pfe
metrics.description: Potential future exposure at a stated confidence and horizon

metrics.name: limit_utilization
metrics.description: Exposure divided by the counterparty limit

conventions.rule: Exposure aggregates within a legally enforceable netting set first; do not sum gross MTMs.
PFE is a quantile; PFEs do not add across netting sets.
State the XVA sign convention (charge to the firm shown as negative or positive).

insight_rules.reason: Quantiles are not additive; use incremental or marginal allocation.

caveats.text: Wrong-way risk (exposure rising as counterparty credit worsens) is not visible in exposure alone.

chart_conventions.rule: Show exposure profiles against time horizon with the limit as a reference line.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
